final_message:
All 6 tests pass. Two bugs, both in `lrucache/cache.py`:

- `get` never called `move_to_end` (`cache.py:29`), so reads didn't refresh recency and frequently-read keys got evicted.
- `put` checked capacity before checking key presence (`cache.py:33`), so updating an existing key at full capacity evicted an innocent entry.

`SOLUTION.md` written with the same explanation.
